name: argus-review
description: Argus — multi-agent code review with effort levels for Claude Code. One isolated reviewer by default (plain); scale to a hundred-eyed panel (medium|high|xhigh|max): lens-partitioned finders, independent verifiers judging every candidate against a strict eight-criterion bug standard, a gap-sweep pass, and adversarial voting. Four review targets with merge-base resolution; every review ends in a decisive findings + verdict block.
